guitar.evidence: Lonnie Mack is famous and well documented for playing one of the earliest Gibson Flying V guitars (serial number 7, nicknamed 'Number Seven'), iconic to his instrumental hit 'Wham!'.

tone.target: raw biting Strat lead with wah and thick springy sustain
tone.profile: raw biting Strat lead with wah and thick springy sustain
tone.summary: A classic blues/rock setup utilizing a Fuzz distortion for bite, followed by an OD boost for sustain, paired with the AC30 TB amp model to achieve a bright, vocal-like tone, finished with Wah and Spring reverb.
corrections: swap high-gain distortion for fuzzier lead drive
add springy amp/room, not lush FX

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray noise from aggressive fuzz and high gain.

blocks.gap: Using Boost as a clean, transparent sustain enhancer after fuzz.

alternatives.reason: Could provide more grit, but Boost is cleaner for lead focus.
